text: The Patriots suffered a 30-24 loss to the Bears on Thursday Night Football in Week 7, with Caleb Williams throwing two touchdown passes to lead Chicago to victory in what amounts to Round 2 between Drake Maye and the young Bears quarterback. The loss was particularly frustrating given that New England struggled with turnover differential—one of Mike Vrabel's four pillars of team identity—a issue that's become increasingly problematic for the squad. On the bright side, Rhamondre Stevenson reached a career high in receiving yards and continues to do all the little things for the offense while approaching 100 carries for the sixth straight season, though the Patriots were without starting guards Alijah Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown due to injuries. Expect analysis of Drake Maye's film performance and the defense's breakdowns to dominate the week's conversation as New England looks for answers on how to climb out of this hole.
